jobs.title: Dental Treatment Coordinator / Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Dental Treatment Coordinator / Patient Care Coordinator**
===========================================================

**Comprehensive Periodontics \& Dental Implants**  

Paso Robles, San Luis Obispo, and Santa Maria/Orcutt, California  

**Full\-time \| $23–$33 per hour****About Our Practice**
----------------------


Comprehensive Periodontics \& Dental Implants is a respected, fast\-paced periodontal and dental implant specialty practice serving patients throughout California’s Central Coast.
We are seeking a motivated, caring, and highly organized Dental Treatment Coordinator who communicates confidently, works well as part of a team, and is committed to providing an exceptional patient experience.
This is more than a traditional receptionist position. The Treatment Coordinator serves as an important connection between our patients, referring dental offices, doctors, and clinical team—from the patient’s first phone call through completion of treatment and follow\-up care.**Position Overview**
---------------------


This is a full\-time, multi\-location position anticipated to include approximately:* Two to three days per week in our Paso Robles office
* One day per week in our Santa Maria/Orcutt office
* One to two days per week in our San Luis Obiso office


The specific combination of days will vary based on practice and patient\-care needs. Reliable transportation and the ability to work at all three locations are required.
Your primary goal will be to ensure that every patient arrives prepared for a well\-coordinated appointment, moves smoothly through the treatment process, and leaves with a clear understanding of their treatment plan, financial responsibilities, and next steps.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Serve as a primary point of contact for patients and referring dental offices.
* Communicate with patients in a warm, professional, and reassuring manner.
* Coordinate patient care from the initial referral or phone call through consultation, treatment, and follow\-up.
* Present treatment plans clearly and help patients understand recommended care, fees, sequencing, and next steps.
* Answer patient questions and address concerns that may otherwise prevent or delay treatment.
* Coordinate appointments, treatment phases, and communication among patients, doctors, clinical team members, and referring offices.
* Manage the appointment schedule and scheduling templates to support efficient patient flow, appropriate clinical utilization, and practice production goals.
* Confirm that required records, referrals, radiographs, medical information, and other documentation are obtained before appointments.
* Assist patients with scheduling, payment arrangements, insurance\-related questions, and applicable practice financial policies.
* Collect payments and ensure that patient accounts and appointment information are complete and accurate.
* Maintain detailed and professional documentation in the patient record.
* Support front\-office operations, including answering phones, greeting patients, scheduling appointments, and responding to messages.
* Help create a calm, organized, and welcoming experience for patients undergoing periodontal and implant treatment.
* Collaborate closely with doctors, clinical team members, and other administrative staff across multiple locations.

**Qualifications**
------------------


The ideal candidate will demonstrate:* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence
* A professional, compassionate, and patient\-centered approach
* Confidence discussing treatment recommendations, fees, and financial responsibilities
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Sound judgment, initiative, and follow\-through
* A positive attitude and genuine team mentality
* Comfort using computers, scheduling systems, and electronic patient records
* Dependable transportation and the ability to work in San Luis Obispo, Santa Maria/Orcutt, and Paso Robles


Previous dental front\-office, treatment\-coordination, scheduling, insurance, or specialty\-practice experience is strongly preferred. Periodontal or dental implant experience is beneficial but not required for a candidate with strong transferable skills and a willingness to learn.
Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus but are not required.**Compensation**
----------------

* $23–$33 per hour
* Compensation is based on relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and overall fit for the position.
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement are available.

**Benefits**
------------


Benefits available to eligible employees include:* Health and vision insurance
* 401(k) matching and profit sharing
* Paid time off
* Health Savings Account
* Aflac supplemental insurance options
* Continuing education support
* Employee dental discount
* On\-the\-job training and opportunities for advancement

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------


We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the patient experience and understands that successful treatment coordination requires both empathy and accountability. The right individual will be comfortable helping patients navigate complex treatment decisions while also supporting the scheduling, financial, and operational needs of the practice.
To apply, please submit your résumé along with a brief introduction describing your dental or patient\-coordination experience and your availability to work across our Paso Robles, San Luis Obispo, and Santa Maria/Orcutt locations.

jobs.title: Clinical Program Manager, Integrated Care - FT - Days - Integrated Care @ MV
jobs.description:
**El Camino Health is committed to hiring, retaining and growing the best and brightest professionals who will carry our mission and vision forward. We are proud of our reputation in the community: One built on compassion, innovation, collaboration and delivering high\-quality care. Come join the team that makes this happen.**

**Applicants MUST apply for position(s) by submitting a separate application for each individual job posting number they are interested in being considered for.**

**FTE**


1**Scheduled Bi\-Weekly Hours**


80**Work Shift**


Day: 8 hours**Job Description**


Form, lead, and facilitate cross\-functional teams in the planning, development, coordination, and implementation of complex enterprise\-wide inpatient and outpatient integrated care, post\-acute, transitional care, and performance improvement initiatives. Coach and advise on efforts that improve efficiency, quality, patient outcomes, and patient experience.

  

Serve as the clinical leader for advancing care of designated patient populations throughout the organization and across the continuum of care, including acute, ambulatory, home, and post\-acute settings.

  

With strategic focus on the CMS Transforming Episode Accountability Model (TEAM), bundled payment models, transitional care, and future value\-based reimbursement initiatives, the role supports episode performance, transitions of care, post\-acute network effectiveness, and measurable improvement in quality, utilization, patient outcomes, and patient experience.

  

Lead performance improvement initiatives through application of clinical expertise, knowledge of both clinical and administrative settings, and frequent interaction with clinical and non\-clinical stakeholders.


Support responsible adoption of AI\-enabled tools, analytics platforms, Epic enhancements, and emerging technologies that improve outreach, care coordination, documentation, and program performance.

 **Job Description**

* Collaborates with leadership and cross\-functional teams to improve evidence\-based practice, clinical outcomes, patient experience, workflow efficiency, and program performance through performance improvement initiatives and gap analysis.
* Leads multidisciplinary teams across the enterprise to integrate best practices into clinical, operational, and transitional care workflows.
* Maintains current knowledge of clinical practice guidelines, regulatory requirements, specialty program operations, and emerging industry best practices.
* Oversees program data generation, analytics review, dashboard development, and presentation of performance results and recommendations to leadership.
* Concurrently monitors care delivery performance across inpatient, outpatient, home, and post\-acute settings, identifying opportunities for intervention, education, and process improvement.
* Provides oversight of post\-discharge follow\-up workflows, outreach strategies, caregiver coordination, continuity of care, and timely follow\-up processes for designated patient populations.
* Serves as a clinical liaison between hospital\-based providers/acute care teams, patients, caregivers, primary care providers, physician offices, and post\-acute partners to support safe and effective transitions of care.
* Oversees processes supporting medication reconciliation, therapy continuation, patient education, and continuity standards in collaboration with appropriate clinical teams.
* Serves as program lead for CMS TEAM workflows including beneficiary notifications, referral processes, compliance requirements, episode tracking, and operational readiness.
* Analyzes TEAM and related program trends including readmissions, emergency department returns, discharge disposition, length of stay, and post\-acute utilization, recommending interventions to improve quality and financial performance.
* Leads implementation of TEAM care pathways in partnership with multidisciplinary teams (physician leadership, nursing leadership, rehabilitation, and Epic/IT).
* Supports implementation and optimization of care management technology, Epic workflows, AI\-enabled tools, and digital solutions that improve outreach efficiency, risk stratification, and documentation quality.
* Educates stakeholders on effective use of approved technologies and workflow enhancements.
* Develops collaborative relationships with aligned skilled nursing facilities, home health agencies, physician offices, and community providers to improve post\-acute outcomes and episode performance.
* Conducts onsite visits to post\-acute partner facilities, as operationally appropriate, to strengthen collaboration, identify barriers, and support care transition performance.
* Conducts program and patient population reviews to identify trends, barriers, and opportunities to improve outcomes, utilization, and patient flow.
* Communicates effectively with executives, physicians, and operational leaders, and supports resource planning, training initiatives, and organizational alignment.
* Complies with regulatory standards, organizational policies, applicable confidentiality requirements, and continuous program advancement.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a work\-related field from an accredited college or university required. Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum three (3\) years of experience leading teams, programs, or initiatives in a clinical setting.
* Experience in care coordination, case management, transitional care, utilization management, population health, or related clinical operations preferred.
* Experience in orthopedic, surgical, cardiac, rehabilitation, post\-acute, or care coordination settings preferred.
* Experience with bundled payment models, value\-based care, post\-acute strategy, and/or payer programs strongly preferred.
* Experience with Epic, analytics dashboards, reporting tools, AI\-enabled workflow tools, and cross\-functional implementation work preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication

Skin Perfect Medical Aesthetics offers a luxurious and modern spa experience for patients. We are looking for a full\-time Patient Care Coordinator to assist with processing our patients.

* Answer and return follow\-up phone calls, set appointments, and manage digital filing.

**Requirements \& Qualifications**

* 2 or more years of customer service experience.
* Med Spa experience is preferred, but not required.
* Call center experience is desirable for this position.
* Fluent Spanish speaker is highly desired, but not required.

We encourage you to include a cover page highlighting your life experiences and interest in the beauty industry.

jobs.title: Remote LPN/LVN Care Coordinator – CCM/RPM (Compact Multistate License Required)
jobs.description:
**About ColigoMed**

ColigoMed is a U.S.\-based digital health company supporting remote care programs for patients with chronic medical conditions.

Our AI\-enabled care platform connects patients, medical providers, and payers to support at\-home and virtual care programs. Our proprietary AI engine, ColigoAssist, supports providers and care teams with real\-time clinical visibility, patient engagement, and chronic care management workflows. We are focused on helping patients live healthier, more independent lives by delivering consistent, high\-quality remote care.

**The Role**

**Schedule:** Full\-time, Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week  
**Hours:** 8:00am to 5:00pm ET  
**Pay:** $22\.00–$25\.00/hour, depending on experience  
**Status:** 1099 contractor initially  
**Future pathway:** Strong performers may be considered for W\-2 employment after 3 months, subject to performance, productivity, compliance standards, and business needs.

ColigoMed is hiring experienced Remote LPN/LVN Care Coordinators to support Chronic Care Management and Remote Patient Monitoring programs across the United States. This role requires:

* An active compact multistate LPN/LVN license
* Direct CCM/RPM or remote chronic care management experience
* Chronic disease management experience
* Prior remote healthcare work experience
* Strong documentation and patient communication skills
* Prior experience managing an assigned patient panel or active caseload in a structured remote care environment
* Successful management of an active remote care caseload of approximately 150\+ patients is strongly preferred

This is a patient\-facing remote nursing role. You will manage an assigned panel of patients, conduct regular outbound patient calls, document care activity accurately, support care plans, and escalate clinical concerns when needed. This role is best suited to nurses who enjoy structured remote workflows, ongoing patient relationships, chronic disease management, and consistent patient engagement.

**Why This Role May Be a Strong Fit**

* Remote nursing role
* Monday to Friday schedule
* No bedside shifts
* Ongoing patient relationships
* Structured CCM/RPM workflows
* Supportive clinical operations team
* Structured onboarding and workflow training provided
* Opportunity to be part of a growing digital health company

**Key Responsibilities**

As a Remote LPN/LVN Chronic Care Coordinator, you will:

* Manage an assigned panel of CCM/RPM patients, including regular outbound calls, follow\-ups, care plan support, and patient education.
* Support patient onboarding, program explanation, consent documentation, RPM setup, and ongoing program participation for Medicare and Medicare Advantage patients.
* Review patient needs, symptoms, medication adherence, care plan progress, barriers to care, and RPM/device issues in accordance with approved workflows.
* Document all patient interactions accurately and on time, including call content, duration, follow\-up needs, care plan updates, barriers to care, and escalation actions where applicable.
* Accurately record actual patient engagement, care coordination activity, follow\-up work, and billable\-support time in accordance with ColigoMed workflows and CCM/RPM documentation requirements.
* Complete assigned patient follow\-up tasks promptly and ensure unresolved patient needs, symptoms, medication concerns, device issues, or escalation items are followed through to completion.
* Escalate clinical concerns appropriately and promptly to providers and/or the Clinical Operations team.
* Maintain care plans in coordination with providers and the Clinical Operations team.
* Meet expected productivity, quality, documentation, compliance, follow\-up, and patient engagement standards.
* Participate in QA review, internal audit feedback, coaching, and process improvement when documentation, follow\-up, timekeeping, or workflow issues are identified.

**Productivity and Quality Expectations**  
This is a structured remote care role with clear expectations for patient engagement, documentation, quality, compliance, and productivity. Successful nurses will be expected to manage regular patient outreach, maintain accurate same\-day documentation, follow standardized CCM/RPM workflows, and meet agreed performance expectations once fully trained and when patient volume supports this level.

Productivity credit must be supported by accurate documentation, appropriate time records, completed patient follow\-up, and compliance with approved workflows. We assess performance across patient engagement, care continuity, documentation quality, compliance, follow\-up completion, call quality, escalation judgment, and productivity. We do not assess performance on volume alone. Quality, compliance, and patient care standards are essential.

**Required Qualifications and Experience** 

Candidates must have:

* Active LPN/LVN compact multistate license.
* Minimum 6–10 years of nursing experience, including chronic disease management.
* At least 2 years of direct experience working in a structured remote CCM, RPM, chronic care management, telehealth, or virtual care company.
* Prior experience working in a structured remote care company, CCM/RPM provider, telehealth company, population health organization, or similar service model where nurses use a digital care\-management platform to manage assigned patient panels, conduct scheduled outreach, document interactions, update care plans, and support billing/compliance workflows.
* Demonstrated experience using a remote care platform, EMR, telehealth system, RPM dashboard, or digital care\-management tool as part of daily clinical workflow.
* Experience managing an assigned panel of patients in a remote or virtual care environment, including regular outbound patient calls, follow\-up tracking, care plan updates, and escalation of clinical concerns.
* Successful management of an active remote care caseload of approximately 150\+ patients is stron

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

Harrisonburg Family Practice is seeking a compassionate and organized **Patient Care Coordinator** to support patients throughout their healthcare experience. This fully remote position serves as a non\-clinical liaison between patients, providers, and administrative departments by coordinating appointments, referrals, follow\-up communications, and patient support services.

The ideal candidate is passionate about delivering outstanding customer service, excels at multitasking, and enjoys helping patients navigate healthcare services while ensuring a positive experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Patient Support**

* Serve as the primary non\-clinical point of contact for patients via phone, email, secure messaging, and virtual communication platforms.
* Assist patients with scheduling appointments, follow\-up visits, annual wellness exams, and preventive care services.
* Answer general questions regarding office procedures, patient services, referrals, and available resources.
* Escalate clinical questions and medical concerns to licensed healthcare professionals.

**Care Coordination**

* Coordinate specialist referrals, diagnostic appointments, and follow\-up care.
* Monitor referral completion and assist patients with appointment coordination.
* Ensure patients receive reminders for upcoming appointments and preventive health services.
* Maintain communication with patients regarding administrative updates and care coordination activities.

**Administrative Responsibilities**

* Maintain accurate patient information within electronic medical record (EMR/EHR) systems.
* Document patient interactions, service requests, and follow\-up activities.
* Prepare patient correspondence, appointment confirmations, and informational materials.
* Assist with updating demographic information and maintaining electronic records.

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with physicians, nurses, referral coordinators, and front office staff to support patient care coordination.
* Coordinate communication between internal departments to ensure timely service delivery.
* Participate in process improvement initiatives focused on enhancing patient satisfaction.
* Support additional administrative projects as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in healthcare administration, patient services, medical office support, customer service, scheduling, insurance verification, office administration, or administrative support.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time\-management abilities.
* Ability to handle confidential information professionally.
* Ability to work independently in a fully remote work environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, EMR/EHR systems, CRM platforms, and web\-based business applications.

**Preferred**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Public Health, Communications, or a related field.
* Experience working in a primary care practice, family medicine office, outpatient clinic, or healthcare organization.
* Familiarity with electronic medical records, patient scheduling software, referral management systems, or healthcare administration platforms.
* Previous remote work experience.

**Core Competencies**

* Patient care coordination
* Customer service
* Healthcare administration
* Appointment scheduling
* Referral coordination
* Communication
* Organization
* Administrative support
* Problem\-solving
* Attention to detail

Pay: $23\.69 \- $28\.53 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: Remote

The specific combination of days will vary based on practice and patient\-care needs. Reliable transportation and the ability to work at all three locations are required.
Your primary goal will be to ensure that every patient arrives prepared for a well\-coordinated appointment, moves smoothly through the treatment process, and leaves with a clear understanding of their treatment plan, financial responsibilities, and next steps.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Serve as a primary point of contact for patients and referring dental offices.
* Communicate with patients in a warm, professional, and reassuring manner.
* Coordinate patient care from the initial referral or phone call through consultation, treatment, and follow\-up.
* Present treatment plans clearly and help patients understand recommended care, fees, sequencing, and next steps.
* Answer patient questions and address concerns that may otherwise prevent or delay treatment.
* Coordinate appointments, treatment phases, and communication among patients, doctors, clinical team members, and referring offices.
* Manage the appointment schedule and scheduling templates to support efficient patient flow, appropriate clinical utilization, and practice production goals.
* Confirm that required records, referrals, radiographs, medical information, and other documentation are obtained before appointments.
* Assist patients with scheduling, payment arrangements, insurance\-related questions, and applicable practice financial policies.
* Collect payments and ensure that patient accounts and appointment information are complete and accurate.
* Maintain detailed and professional documentation in the patient record.
* Support front\-office operations, including answering phones, greeting patients, scheduling appointments, and responding to messages.
* Help create a calm, organized, and welcoming experience for patients undergoing periodontal and implant treatment.
* Collaborate closely with doctors, clinical team members, and other administrative staff across multiple locations.

**Qualifications**
------------------


The ideal candidate will demonstrate:* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence
* A professional, compassionate, and patient\-centered approach
* Confidence discussing treatment recommendations, fees, and financial responsibilities
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Sound judgment, initiative, and follow\-through
* A positive attitude and genuine team mentality
* Comfort using computers, scheduling systems, and electronic patient records
* Dependable transportation and the ability to work in San Luis Obispo, Santa Maria/Orcutt, and Paso Robles


Previous dental front\-office, treatment\-coordination, scheduling, insurance, or specialty\-practice experience is strongly preferred. Periodontal or dental implant experience is beneficial but not required for a candidate with strong transferable skills and a willingness to learn.
Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus but are not required.**Compensation**
----------------

* $23–$33 per hour
* Compensation is based on relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and overall fit for the position.
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement are available.

**Benefits**
------------


Benefits available to eligible employees include:* Health and vision insurance
* 401(k) matching and profit sharing
* Paid time off
* Health Savings Account
* Aflac supplemental insurance options
* Continuing education support
* Employee dental discount
* On\-the\-job training and opportunities for advancement

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------


We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the patient experience and understands that successful treatment coordination requires both empathy and accountability. The right individual will be comfortable helping patients navigate complex treatment decisions while also supporting the scheduling, financial, and operational needs of the practice.
To apply, please submit your résumé along with a brief introduction describing your dental or patient\-coordination experience and your availability to work across our San Luis Obispo, Santa Maria/Orcutt, and Paso Robles locations.

new_jobs.title: Remote LPN/LVN Care Coordinator – CCM/RPM (Compact Multistate License Required)
new_jobs.description:
**About ColigoMed**

ColigoMed is a U.S.\-based digital health company supporting remote care programs for patients with chronic medical conditions.

Our AI\-enabled care platform connects patients, medical providers, and payers to support at\-home and virtual care programs. Our proprietary AI engine, ColigoAssist, supports providers and care teams with real\-time clinical visibility, patient engagement, and chronic care management workflows. We are focused on helping patients live healthier, more independent lives by delivering consistent, high\-quality remote care.

**The Role**

**Schedule:** Full\-time, Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week  
**Hours:** 8:00am to 5:00pm ET  
**Pay:** $22\.00–$25\.00/hour, depending on experience  
**Status:** 1099 contractor initially  
**Future pathway:** Strong performers may be considered for W\-2 employment after 3 months, subject to performance, productivity, compliance standards, and business needs.

ColigoMed is hiring experienced Remote LPN/LVN Care Coordinators to support Chronic Care Management and Remote Patient Monitoring programs across the United States. This role requires:

* An active compact multistate LPN/LVN license
* Direct CCM/RPM or remote chronic care management experience
* Chronic disease management experience
* Prior remote healthcare work experience
* Strong documentation and patient communication skills
* Prior experience managing an assigned patient panel or active caseload in a structured remote care environment
* Successful management of an active remote care caseload of approximately 150\+ patients is strongly preferred

This is a patient\-facing remote nursing role. You will manage an assigned panel of patients, conduct regular outbound patient calls, document care activity accurately, support care plans, and escalate clinical concerns when needed. This role is best suited to nurses who enjoy structured remote workflows, ongoing patient relationships, chronic disease management, and consistent patient engagement.

**Why This Role May Be a Strong Fit**

* Remote nursing role
* Monday to Friday schedule
* No bedside shifts
* Ongoing patient relationships
* Structured CCM/RPM workflows
* Supportive clinical operations team
* Structured onboarding and workflow training provided
* Opportunity to be part of a growing digital health company

**Key Responsibilities**

As a Remote LPN/LVN Chronic Care Coordinator, you will:

* Manage an assigned panel of CCM/RPM patients, including regular outbound calls, follow\-ups, care plan support, and patient education.
* Support patient onboarding, program explanation, consent documentation, RPM setup, and ongoing program participation for Medicare and Medicare Advantage patients.
* Review patient needs, symptoms, medication adherence, care plan progress, barriers to care, and RPM/device issues in accordance with approved workflows.
* Document all patient interactions accurately and on time, including call content, duration, follow\-up needs, care plan updates, barriers to care, and escalation actions where applicable.
* Accurately record actual patient engagement, care coordination activity, follow\-up work, and billable\-support time in accordance with ColigoMed workflows and CCM/RPM documentation requirements.
* Complete assigned patient follow\-up tasks promptly and ensure unresolved patient needs, symptoms, medication concerns, device issues, or escalation items are followed through to completion.
* Escalate clinical concerns appropriately and promptly to providers and/or the Clinical Operations team.
* Maintain care plans in coordination with providers and the Clinical Operations team.
* Meet expected productivity, quality, documentation, compliance, follow\-up, and patient engagement standards.
* Participate in QA review, internal audit feedback, coaching, and process improvement when documentation, follow\-up, timekeeping, or workflow issues are identified.

**Productivity and Quality Expectations**  
This is a structured remote care role with clear expectations for patient engagement, documentation, quality, compliance, and productivity. Successful nurses will be expected to manage regular patient outreach, maintain accurate same\-day documentation, follow standardized CCM/RPM workflows, and meet agreed performance expectations once fully trained and when patient volume supports this level.

Productivity credit must be supported by accurate documentation, appropriate time records, completed patient follow\-up, and compliance with approved workflows. We assess performance across patient engagement, care continuity, documentation quality, compliance, follow\-up completion, call quality, escalation judgment, and productivity. We do not assess performance on volume alone. Quality, compliance, and patient care standards are essential.

**Required Qualifications and Experience** 

Candidates must have:

* Active LPN/LVN compact multistate license.
* Minimum 6–10 years of nursing experience, including chronic disease management.
* At least 2 years of direct experience working in a structured remote CCM, RPM, chronic care management, telehealth, or virtual care company.
* Prior experience working in a structured remote care company, CCM/RPM provider, telehealth company, population health organization, or similar service model where nurses use a digital care\-management platform to manage assigned patient panels, conduct scheduled outreach, document interactions, update care plans, and support billing/compliance workflows.
* Demonstrated experience using a remote care platform, EMR, telehealth system, RPM dashboard, or digital care\-management tool as part of daily clinical workflow.
* Experience managing an assigned panel of patients in a remote or virtual care environment, including regular outbound patient calls, follow\-up tracking, care plan updates, and escalation of clinical concerns.
